attention_impl.chosen: explicit softmax (exact: fwd rel 2.46e-07, grad_x 2.78e-07 vs sdpa)

why_v3_trains_slower: the block does qkv(192->576) + out(192->192) + SwiGLU(192->768, 384->192) at 62 bands, i.e. 2112 channel-widths of GEMM per token per level vs 1344 for v1's depthwise block (1.57x). Inference is faster because v3 replaces v1's 4-block 8-band temporal stack with 2 transformer layers + 1 MSC.
